- Cost center: 4021-FPNA (Sr FP&A) — budget flagged in Q3 plan
- Cost center: 4039-BillingOps (Billing Analyst) — requested as headcount add, will require headcount form submission (attached).

Candidates:

- Recruiting has two internal feeder candidates for Sr FP&A; preferred candidate identified pending comp signoff.

Ask:
1) Approve the two headcount additions and the comp bands above (or provide updated ranges).
2) Confirm any required Exec / Finance signoff for equity beyond listed amounts.
3) Permission to extend verbal offers and initiate background checks once comp is confirmed.

Attachments: sr_fpna_jobdesc.pdf, billing_ops_comp_band.xlsx, headcount_request_form_#452.pdf
